title: Michelle Mishy Mash
style: Jazz swing big band with a 1970s lounge sway, shuffle-walking drums, upright bass, tight brass hits, trumpet stabs, and flashy Spanish guitar licks; verse rides smoky horn comp and playful female lead trade-offs, pre-chorus strips to bass and brushed snare, chorus snaps with full brass shout and group harmonies, bridge drops to trumpet-and-clap break before a final key lift. Close-mic female vocals with doubled hooks, cheeky ad-libs, short delay throws on the title phrase, rim-shot accents, crowd-like backing shouts, bright punchy mix with vintage tape sheen., jazz, swing, big band
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle, mishy, mushy, hey
Black truck hit me yesterday
Right leg hurt, but I can walk
Still got fire when I talk

Court shoes wait by the door
I’m not quitting, I want more
Old tennis foot, new little game
Different bounce, but same last name

[Pre-Chorus]
Step by step
I find my groove
Little by little
I make my move

[Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Oh, Michelle)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
I don’t run, I still dash
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(¡Dale, dale!)
Serve it soft, then crack that flash

[Verse 2]
Hold that paddle loose, not tight
Aim to dink, then swing it right
Keep it low, kiss the tape
Make them reach, make them scrape

Little third-shot drop in place
Then I own that kitchen space
Turn my pain into my grin
Watch me work, and watch me win

[Pre-Chorus]
Breathe in slow
Eyes on the line
One more step
And I’m feeling fine

[Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Oh, Michelle)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
I don’t run, I still dash
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(¡Dale, dale!)
Serve it soft, then crack that flash

[Bridge]
Trumpet cries, then the room leans in
I’m still dancing through the spin
One good bounce, one clean reply
I can walk, so I still fly

[Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Oh, Michelle)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
I don’t run, I still dash
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(¡Dale, dale!)
Serve it soft, then crack that flash
